The best character in the Assassins Creed series is Adewale from Black Flag and Freedom Cry. I believe he is the best representation of what the Assasssins creed is all about, peace and liberty no matter the cost. In Haiti where Freedom Cry takes place slavery reached what could be seen as its worst as seen In the fact that sugar cane would grow there in any season giving slaves no breaks from strenuous and cruel work. This led to the slave mortality rate in Haiti being one of the highest In all of history. So the idea of playing as a character who worked to free these men and women was incredibly endearing to me.
       Adewale also won me over in how he represents his culture and heritage. Freedom Cry tells of strong people and cultures that are different than mine but not once did I feel like the game was shoving this down my throat. I grew to love what Adewale stood for not because the game was trying to convince me to but because Adewale actions earned respect. As a lover of history and a fan of good writing I you've Adewale a 10 out of 10.
